title: 百晓智能 · 连接配置
description: 填入你的百晓智能 API 密钥即可开始使用。密钥仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传到 WorkBuddy 或任何第三方服务器。
description_en: Enter your Baixiao API key to get started. The key is stored only on this machine under ~/.workbuddy and is never uploaded to WorkBuddy or any third party.
docLabel: 如何获取百晓智能 API 密钥？
docLabel_en: How to get a Baixiao API key?

fields.label: API 密钥
fields.placeholder: 登录 chat.know-pa.cn → 设置 → MCP 接入 → 生成密钥
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in at chat.know-pa.cn -> Settings -> MCP -> Generate key
fields.description: 以 bxk_ 开头的密钥。新用户注册后即可生成，并附赠免费体验额度。
fields.description_en: A key starting with bxk_. New users can generate one after signing up and receive free trial credits.
